title: Stability and Hopf Bifurcation of a Delayed SVIRS Epidemic Model with Media Coverage
summary: This paper formulates and analyzes a delayed SVIRS epidemic model incorporating media coverage effects, vaccination, waning immunity, temporary post-recovery immunity, saturated treatment, and delayed behavioral responses induced by media coverage. The positivity and uniform boundedness of solutions are established, the basic reproduction number is derived, and the local and global asymptotic stability of the disease-free and endemic equilibria is investigated.
